# mimecast_web_security_url_policy (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Web Security URL/domain allow or block policy with its target scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Mimecast does not expose a list endpoint for this policy family. Use the
# import command with a policy ID from the Administration Console to seed state.
resource "mimecast_web_security_url_policy" "example" {
  description = "tf-example-web-security"

  targets = [
    {
      policy = {
        description   = "tf-example-web-security-target"
        enabled       = true
        enforced      = true
        override      = false
        bidirectional = false
        from_eternal  = true
        to_eternal    = true
        from = {
          type = "everyone"
        }
        to = {
          type = "everyone"
        }
      }
    }
  ]

  url_actions = [
    {
      action = "block"
      type   = "domain"
      value  = "blocked.example"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Web Security policy description.
- `targets` (Attributes List) Policy target scopes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))
- `url_actions` (Attributes List) Domains or URLs and their allow/block actions. List identity is matched by type, value, and action so returned IDs do not reorder configured items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--url_actions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast Web Security policy ID.

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `policy` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets--policy))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Mimecast target policy ID.

<a id="nestedatt--targets--policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets.policy`

Required:

- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `from` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets--policy--from))
- `to` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets--policy--to))

Optional:

- `bidirectional` (Boolean) Whether the policy applies in both mail-flow directions.
- `comment` (String) Policy comment.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enforced.
- `from_date` (String) Policy start time in Mimecast ISO 8601 format.
- `from_eternal` (Boolean) Whether the policy has no scheduled start.
- `from_part` (String) Sender address part used for matching.
- `hostnames` (Set of String) Source hostnames used as policy conditions. Supported by Web Security target policies.
- `override` (Boolean) Whether the policy is evaluated before lower-priority matches.
- `source_ips` (Set of String) Source IP ranges in CIDR notation.
- `spf_domains` (Set of String) SPF domains used as policy conditions. Supported by Web Security target policies.
- `to_date` (String) Policy end time in Mimecast ISO 8601 format.
- `to_eternal` (Boolean) Whether the policy has no scheduled end.

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) Policy creation time returned by Mimecast.
- `last_updated` (String) Most recent policy update time returned by Mimecast.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# This API family has no list endpoint. Get the policy ID from the Mimecast Administration Console first.
terraform import mimecast_web_security_url_policy.example web-security-policy-id
```
